name: Kohaku Brasserie
description: A serene WordPress theme designed for Kohaku Brasserie, capturing the calm rhythm of a working city dining room from lunch to last orders. Features low-key documentary photography, refined serif typography, and signature pacing devices including a service-day timeline hairline and pinned letterbox windows. Built for booking-led hospitality with full-width price ledgers, multi-sitting schedules, and clean responsive layouts across five locales.

fonts.role: display: wordmark, headings, nav, prices (variable 100-900, Latin subset)
text: body, labels, ledgers (variable 200-900, Latin subset)
display for Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) pages: headings and the wordmark (Regular 400, subset to the zh-TW sample text; never a Japanese font)

summary.en: City brasserie theme: a full-bleed low-key photograph that cross-fades lunch, afternoon and late sitting over a service-day hairline with an amber marker, a pinned letterbox window, a plate-rim ellipse and a full-width price ledger.
